initial.name: bash
initial.description:
Run commands in a bash shell
* When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
* Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
* State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
* To inspect a particular line range of a file, e.g. lines 10-25, try 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'.
* Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
* Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'sleep 10 &' or start a server in the background.

command.description: The bash command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

initial.name: schedule_create
initial.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters, shown on the task card and in task lists.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

initial.name: schedule_delete
initial.description: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive. Deletion does not retract a reminder message that is already queued.

initial.name: schedule_list
initial.description: List the active reminders in the current session.

initial.name: schedule_update
initial.description: Change a reminder in place, keeping its id. Supply a new title, prompt, or at most one timing parameter; omitted fields keep their stored values. To change a relative delay, create a new reminder.

title.description: New task name of at most 120 characters.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.
